text:
Non emergono contraddizioni interne né discrepanze tra budget proposto e confermato, poiché il documento non presenta valori alternativi o revisionati.

Tuttavia, si rilevano incongruenze logiche di stato:
1. Le pratiche **P13-000**, **P13-003**, **P13-004**, **P13-007** e **P13-008** sono marcate come "approvate", ma la loro revisione dipende ancora da un disegno aggiornato. Solitamente, l'approvazione presuppone la finalizzazione dei documenti tecnici.
2. Le pratiche **P13-001**, **P13-005** e **P13-009** sono "sospese", rendendo la dipendenza dalla revisione del disegno un fattore bloccante coerente, ma non risolutivo.
3. La pratica **P13-006** ha scadenza indefinita ("da definire"), creando incertezza operativa rispetto alle altre date fissate.

Gli importi sono dichiarati preventivi (Riga 11), quindi non confrontabili con consuntivi.<|im_end|>
prompt_en:
Look for internal contradictions and differences between proposed and confirmed budgets.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-000, status approved, budget 7976 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-001, status suspended, budget 1091 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-002, status under review, budget 3182 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-003, status approved, budget 7235 euros, deadline 2026-11-17. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-004, status approved, budget 6300 euros, deadline 2026-11-18. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-005, status suspended, budget 2677 euros, deadline 2026-11-19. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-006, status under review, budget 7113 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P13-007, status approved, budget 8274 euros, deadline 2026-11-21. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P13-008, status approved, budget 6482 euros, deadline 2026-11-22. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P13-009, status suspended, budget 4603 euros, deadline 2026-11-23. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.

answer_en:
No internal contradictions or discrepancies emerge between the proposed and confirmed budget, since the document does not present alternative or revised values.

However, logical state inconsistencies are detected:
1. The practices **P13-000**, **P13-003**, **P13-004**, **P13-007** and **P13-008** are marked as "approved", but their revision still depends on an updated drawing. Usually, approval presupposes the finalization of the technical documents.
2. Practices **P13-001**, **P13-005** and **P13-009** are "suspended", making the reliance on design review a consistent, but not conclusive, blocking factor.
3. The **P13-006** practice has an indefinite deadline ("to be defined"), creating operational uncertainty with respect to the other fixed dates.

The amounts are declared as estimates (Line 11), therefore not comparable with final figures.<|im_end|>
